en: Brrrring! Brrrring! It's the Pokégear...
Baoba
Hello, {player}! Warden Baoba here. Sorry to keep you waiting, but my Safari Zone is open at last!
text: Salut, {player}! Aici Paznicul Baoba. Scuze că te-am făcut să aștepți, dar Zona mea Safari s-a deschis în sfârșit!

en: Do you know the gate in the cave behind Cianwood City? Go through it and follow the cliff path, and you'll be there in no time.
text: Știi poarta din peștera din spatele Orașului Cianwood? Treci prin ea și urmează poteca de pe stâncă și ajungi într-o clipă.

en: We're a little out of the way, but do come and visit!
text: Suntem puțin ascunși, dar vino să ne vizitezi!

en: Click... The call has ended.
{rival}
...You again. If you're here for the Gym, don't bother. The Leader's not even in it.
text: ...Din nou tu. Dacă ai venit pentru Arenă, nu te obosi. Liderul nici măcar nu e în ea.

en: She's up that lighthouse, fussing over some sick Pokémon. A Gym Leader playing nurse!
text: E sus, în far, ocupată cu niște Pokémoni bolnavi. Un Lider de Arenă în rol de asistentă!

en: A Pokémon too weak to stand isn't worth the time. You'd waste yours on it too, wouldn't you? That's why you'll never be strong.
text: Un Pokémon prea slab ca să stea în picioare nu merită timpul. Și tu ți-l risipești pe el, nu-i așa? De-asta n-o să fii niciodată puternic.

en: Lockwork moves its cargo quietly. You've seen too much of it already.
That one's heart is locked tight. It'll fight for me without a second thought.
Tch. Doesn't matter. The cargo's already on its way.
Keep walking. Lockwork doesn't forget a face.
You're on the dock without a docket. Lockwork doesn't like that.
My partner here was locked at the works. It obeys. That's all it needs to do.
You knocked the numbers right out of my ledger.
I'm counting crates. Count yourself out of here.
Nobody asked you to look in the crates.
A locked heart never hesitates. Let me show you.
So hesitation isn't everything after all.
Go on. The admin will be the one to deal with you.
This stretch of the harbour is Lockwork's for the evening.
We seal their hearts so nothing ever comes between us. Efficient, isn't it?
Efficient. And beaten. Wonderful.
Lockwork pays well. I'd still rather not face you twice.
Down there's the admin's office. Go on, then. You'll come back up quicker than you went in.
